title: Tail-shedding Metricization and Regional Circuit Scorer + Dashboard Playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Define and implement a repeatable metricization approach for tail-focused load-shedding decisions across regions. Deliverables: 1) a composite token-latency SLI that separates prefix vs. generation contributions and folds in error rates, 2) a regional circuit 'health score' used by autoshed/circuit-breaker logic, 3) dashboard panels to visualize contributors to tail latency and the health score per region/shard, and 4) an operational playbook mapping signals -> shedding actions and escalation steps. This ticket bridges instrumentation (metrics + histograms), runtime tagging (region, shard, priority), and visualization + runbook for on-call and SRE-run rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Composite SLI implemented and exported to metrics backend (Prometheus + clickhouse ingestion) with stable schema and docs
Regional circuit score computed every 30s and send to runtime routing service; sample queries available in console
Dashboards: Overview panel (regional p50/p95/p99 token latency split by prefix/generation), Heatmap of circuit score, Incident timeline linked to shedding actions
Playbook published to Confluence with explicit thresholds, canary rollout plan, and rollback criteria
Automated unit + integration tests for SLI derivation and score calculation merged and reviewed
tasks: Design composite SLI formula and produce short RFC
Add metric tags in serving runtime: token_phase=(prefix|gen), region, shard, model_variant, priority
Emit percentiles plus histogram buckets for token latency to metrics backend
Implement regional circuit score microservice + gRPC API for router to consume
Create Grafana dashboard panels and Console tile for team overview
Write playbook & runbook; coordinate with SRE and Oncall for tabletop exercise
Rollout in two phases: internal staging -> canary in us-west-2 -> global
